data.title: 爱丽丝 · 金木樨树下的圣剑守护
data.description: 盛开着满树芬芳的黄金金木樨树下，爱丽丝身披白金战甲与纯白披风，手按金木樨之剑剑柄，金色花瓣如雨洒落，气势威严圣洁。
data.action: hand on sword hilt, golden petals raining around, serene resolute gaze
data.lighting: glorious golden daylight cascading through blooming golden blossom boughs
data.mood: breathtakingly noble and sacred chivalric atmosphere
data.promptProse: Beneath a grand blooming osmanthus tree showering fragrant golden petals, Alice stands poised in her ornate Integrity Knight armor, resting her hand upon her sacred blade.
data.animaCaption: Alice standing resolutely in golden armor beneath blooming osmanthus petals.
